description: Search for products available in nearby physical stores in Spain. Pass lat/lon, or a place name if you do not have coordinates. Returns stores ordered by usefulness (priced and in stock first), each with up to 3 matching products: price, availability, trust level, and distance. Queries work best in Spanish ("leche entera", "ibuprofeno 600"). If the result is empty, retry with a larger radius (e.g. 5000) or a more generic term. Fields that are unknown are omitted. When availability_status is unknown or unreachable, do NOT affirm availability — recommend the user confirms with the store directly.
name: products-search-nearby
title: Products Search Nearby
